dialog.shop_open: We sell blessings. Charms. Items blessed by--twin moons. Power doubled--through unity. Like us.
dialog.shop_prompt: Twin-blessed items. Moon charms. Sun--medallions. Together stronger.
haggle: Our prices are fair. Two minds--
purchase_fail: Not meant for you. We both--
rumor: The sun and moon reader knows--
The brown coat walked here once.--
dialog.quest_hook: The Echo Chamber needs resonance. Our voices alone cannot--complete the ritual. Need three voices. Three points. Help us--sing to the mountain. Reward: the Twin's Blessing. Rare. Powerful.
dialog.quest_active: The chamber waits. Three points. Triangle formation.--Sing when we sing. Harmonize. The mountain will answer.
dialog.quest_complete: Perfect harmony! The mountain sings back! Here--take this. Our combined blessing. You are twin-friend now.
dialog.quest_reward: Twin's Blessing - Shared buffs with allies
farewell: Go with both sun and moon--
dialog.time_dawn: Between night and day--our favorite time. Balance.
dialog.time_noon: Sun high. Sol's power--peaks. I support from shadow.
dialog.time_dusk: Twilight belongs to both--of us. Perfect equality.
dialog.time_night: Moon reigns. Luna leads--I follow. Then we switch.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The harmonizer returns! The mountain--still remembers your voice. Beautiful.

party_reactions.kade: Which one...? No, don't tell me. I'll figure it out.
party_reactions.twist: You finish each other's... everything? COOL!
party_reactions.renna: A magical bond. Rare and precious.

relationship_dialog.stranger: New presence. We sense--you together. Interesting.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning. Both of us--recognize you. Welcome back.
relationship_dialog.friend: Twin-friend. Trusted by--both. Rare and honored.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You are our third. Not by blood--but by spirit. Family.

mini_quest.title: Echo Chamber
mini_quest.description: Help the twins complete the resonance ritual in the Echo Chamber
